name: biomed-dispatch
description: Dispatch biomedical research and data analysis tasks to Claude Code with K-Dense Scientific Skills. Use this skill when the user asks to run any bioinformatics, genomics, drug discovery, clinical data analysis, proteomics, multi-omics, medical imaging, or scientific computation task. Also use for literature search (PubMed, bioRxiv), pathway analysis, protein structure prediction, or scientific writing tasks.

findings.excerpt: cd "$TASK_DIR" && claude -p "短任务描述。先读 skill 文件。完成后: openclaw system event --text 'Done: 摘要' --mode now" \
cd writing_outputs/<task_name> && claude -p "读 ~/next-medgeai/MedgeClaw/scientific-skills/scientific-skills/literature-review/SKILL.md 和 scientific-writing/SKIL
claude --dangerously-skip-permissions -p "Use DESeq2 scientific skill. Run differential expression. Counts: /workspace/data/counts.csv, metadata: /workspace/dat
claude --dangerously-skip-permissions -p "Use Scanpy scientific skill. Analyze 10X data at /workspace/data/10x/. QC, clustering, markers. Save to /workspace/dat
- If Claude Code returns an error about a missing package, retry with `uv pip install [package]` prepended to the command
